**Candidate of Technical Sciences, Associate Professor at the TUSUR Department of Telecommunications and Basic Principles of Radio Engineering**



## Research

He studies non-orthogonal multiple access in multi-antenna wireless systems. His research consultant is Alexander Filatov, Doctor of Technical Sciences and Professor at the Department of Telecommunications and Basic Principles of Radio Engineering.

## Publications

He has authored or co-authored 21 publications in journals recommended by VAK and 15 in Russian "White List" journals. His work also includes 15 papers in national conference proceedings and 65 in international conference proceedings.

## Projects and grants

He participated in RSF No. 19-79-00087 "Using non-orthogonal multiple access methods for wireless communication systems" and RSF No. 22-79-10148 "Advanced multiple access methods for future 6G wireless communication systems". His work on TUSUR Priority 2030 and Advanced Engineering School projects covered LDPC and polar codes, 5G NR channel coding and digital distortion compensation.

In 2024, he contributed to software and signal processing algorithms for a radio-relay modem under a TUSUR contract with Micran.

## Intellectual property

His contributions include the inventions "Channel estimation method in orthogonal frequency division multiplexing data transmission systems using Compressed Sensing" and "Radiometric receiver for low-intensity noise signals", software registrations for SCMA, SCMA-MIMO, MIMO, NOMA, polar coding, and multi-user communication system models, and the utility models "Device for transmitting information through power circuits" and "Transceiver module of a radar system".

## Awards

Laureate of the Legislative Duma of Tomsk Region award in Technical Sciences in 2018. Laureate of the Tomsk Region award in education, science, healthcare, and culture in 2024.
